name: Historic Main Street
blurb: Heart of Old Town: mining-era storefronts, galleries, restaurants, and winter string lights.

name: Town Lift Plaza
blurb: Ski-in / ski-out chairlift rising straight from Old Town up to Park City Mountain.

name: Egyptian Theatre
blurb: 1926 Art Deco landmark on Main Street and longtime Sundance venue.

name: Park City Museum
blurb: Silver-mining history and the original basement territorial jail right on Main Street.

name: No Name Saloon
blurb: Classic Park City apres-ski watering hole with a heated rooftop patio.

name: High West Saloon
blurb: Ski-in gastro-distillery right at the bottom of Quit'N Time ski run.

name: Old Town Transit Center
blurb: Hub for Park City's free electric buses and the Main Street Trolley.

name: China Bridge Parking
blurb: Multi-level public garage with elevator access straight up to Main Street.

name: Quit'N Time Run (Town Finish)
blurb: Groomed blue run winding right through Old Town to High West and Town Lift.

name: Park City Mountain Base (PayDay Lift)
blurb: Main base village with PayDay Express, First Time, and Eagle lifts.

name: Deer Valley Snow Park Lodge
blurb: Base area for Deer Valley Resort, a quick free-bus ride south of Main Street.
